name: Roots Routes
source:
An interactive graphic novel game based on family roots and generational trauma, specifically focusing on domestic abuse and the effect on the children who witness it.

[From [url=https://jacobdwoodman.itch.io/roots-routes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款基于家庭根源和代际创伤的互动图画小说游戏，特别关注家庭暴力及其对目睹家庭暴力的儿童的影响。

[来自[url=https://jacobdwoodman.itch.io/roots-routes]Itch.io[/url]]
